resolution.note: retire removes finished project terminals (hc rm) and treats a sleep-only poll shell as a waiter, so a done predecessor with a stale monitor closes; the label and ledger paths already closed a predecessor without env

title: Successor retire closes the predecessor tab and removes finished terminals
body:
Source: operator question 2026-11-17 (why are historical Herdr tabs not closed). My retire at session start printed only "kept tab t1y"/"kept tab t1z": the predecessor t1y (done, work committed) stayed because retire closes only tabs labelled "handed off → " and the predecessor pane only when KRN_PREDECESSOR_PANE/SESSION are set, and it never runs hc rm on finished terminals (13 finished krn terminals had piled up).
Outcome: node scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts --retire closes a done predecessor launched without the label or env pair when its launch record names this successor, and removes finished terminals of the project; a test with a captured hc ls fixture exits 0.
Proof: the retire test reads a verbatim hc ls capture and asserts the close and rm calls.
